name: the empty orchestra
source:
Sometimes you need to do something a little out of the ordinary, a little out of your comfort zone.

Sometimes you need to talk to a stranger.

The game isn't meant to be exciting or filled with huge dramatic moments, it's meant to just show two people interacting. Two people who might not be so unlike yourself. It takes place in Osaka, Japan and is themed around karaoke and music.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25910]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
有时你需要做一些不寻常的事情，稍微超出你的舒适区。

有时你需要与陌生人交谈。

该游戏并不意味着令人兴奋或充满巨大的戏剧性时刻，它的目的只是展示两个人的互动。两个可能与你不太相似的人。它发生在日本大阪，以卡拉OK和音乐为主题。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25910]引理软论坛[/url]]
